newsitem.title: CANADA: Kinross rises on update of Nevada property.
newsitem.headline: Kinross rises on update of Nevada property.

text.p: Kinross Gold Corp sparked investor interest on Tuesday after releasing an update on its Goldbanks joint venture in Nevada.
Shares in the mid-tier gold company rose C$0.40 to C$9.85 in heavy trading of more than 743,000 shares by midday.
Kinross said late Monday it had completed 903 drill holes totalling more than 567,000 feet in the project area.

The company said its mineral resource estimate for the entire property as of December 9, 1996, totals 145 million tons of ore with an average gold grade of 0.029 ounces per ton, containing about 4.2 million ounces of gold.

Kinross said the estimate was based on a cutoff grade of 0.011 ounces per ton. Using a lower cutoff grade of 0.0005 ounces per ton, Kinross said the deposit contained an additional 2.0 million ounces of gold.
Kinross also said it discovered two new areas of gold mineralization on the property through widely spaced exploration drill holes.
